## Natural history notes

A small, nonnative gecko characterized by its pale gray to tan body, slightly translucent skin, large eyes, and flattened toe pads that allow it to climb walls and ceilings. In Florida, it is commonly found around buildings, porches, lights, walls, and other urban or suburban structures. It is mostly active at night and often feeds on insects and other small invertebrates attracted to artificial lights.
